correction: A cross-review's brief never promises a patch for every file of a GitHub compare: a compare lists at most 300 files, pages its commits and leaves out the patch of a file too large or binary, upstream of any cut team_github notes, so the brief says to read each commit or the file at both commits then, and to say in the verdict what could not be read.
